findings.title: Homepage returns HTTP 503
findings.evidence: The homepage at https://www.amazon.com/ returned HTTP 503. Crawlers and AI agents cannot retrieve any content. [Also: structured-data-content-audit: Homepage (https://www.amazon.com/) has no JSON-LD with an Organization, WebSite, or brand entity type. Found types: none. AI assistants cannot reliably identify and describe this brand.] [Also: structured-data-content-audit: Homepage (https://www.amazon.com/) has h1: []. No primary topic signal for crawlers.] [Also: entity-identity-audit: Disparate identity signals detected vs canonical 'www': homepage_title ('Amazon.com'). AI search agents cross-reference title, H1, and JSON-LD to ground entity identity.]

suggested_action.summary: Fix the server error on the homepage immediately.

findings.title: No canonical tags on any crawled page
findings.evidence: 0 of 1 crawled pages contain a <link rel='canonical'> tag. Without canonicals, duplicate content dilutes AI citation quality.

suggested_action.summary: Add <link rel='canonical'> to every page pointing to its preferred URL.

findings.title: High rate of broken internal links (1/1 pages)
findings.evidence: 1 of 1 crawled pages returned HTTP 4xx/5xx errors (100%).

suggested_action.summary: Fix or redirect broken URLs. Audit internal links site-wide.

findings.title: No primary call-to-action found on homepage
findings.evidence: Homepage (https://www.amazon.com/) has no link text matching CTA patterns. Actual link texts found: ['Conditions of Use', 'Privacy Policy'].

suggested_action.summary: Add a prominent primary CTA button above the fold (e.g. 'Get Started', 'Try Free').

findings.title: Homepage lacks a clear value proposition
findings.evidence: Homepage heading text: 'none'. Visible text sample: 'Click the button below to continue shopping Continue shopping Conditions of Use Privacy Policy © 1996-2025, Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates'. No clear statement of who the product/service is for or what it does.

suggested_action.summary: Add an H1 stating who you help and how; add a sub-headline with one key benefit.

findings.title: Navigation has fewer than 3 meaningful text labels
findings.evidence: Homepage has only 2 meaningful internal link text(s): ['Conditions of Use', 'Privacy Policy']. Navigation may be icon-only or unlabelled.

suggested_action.summary: Add visible text labels to all navigation items; avoid icon-only navigation.

findings.title: No date signals found on any crawled page
findings.evidence: Checked 1 pages: no Last-Modified headers, no datePublished, and no dateModified in any JSON-LD block. AI assistants cannot assess content currency. [Also: structured-data-content-audit: Crawled 1 pages; 0/1 contain JSON-LD structured data. AI assistants cannot extract machine-readable facts about this site.]

suggested_action.summary: Add Last-Modified headers and datePublished/dateModified to JSON-LD on all content pages.

findings.title: Missing title or meta description on 1/1 pages
findings.evidence: 1 of 1 pages (100%) are missing a <title> and/or <meta name='description'>.

suggested_action.summary: Add unique, descriptive title tags and meta descriptions to every page.

findings.title: Thin content on 1/1 pages (<200 characters)
findings.evidence: 1 of 1 pages (100%) have fewer than 200 visible characters. AI assistants have little content to cite.

suggested_action.summary: Expand thin pages with substantive content or consolidate them.

findings.title: No About or team page detected
findings.evidence: None of 1 crawled URLs match about/team page patterns, and no title contains 'About' or 'Our Team'. First-time visitors cannot learn who is behind the site. [Also: entity-identity-audit: None of 1 crawled URLs match about-page patterns (/about, /who-we-are, /our-story, ...) and no page title contains 'About'.]

suggested_action.summary: Create an About page introducing the team/company and mission.

findings.title: Brand name 'www' may be ambiguous or generic
findings.evidence: Detected brand name 'www' is short (3 chars) or uses only common words, creating disambiguation risk for AI agents.

suggested_action.summary: Add disambiguatingDescription and sameAs to Organisation JSON-LD; use full legal name.

findings.title: No contact or support link found across any crawled page
findings.evidence: No link text across 1 crawled pages matches contact/support patterns (contact, support, help, chat, ...).

suggested_action.summary: Add a 'Contact' or 'Support' link to the site header or footer.

proactive_recommendations.title: Complete OpenGraph tags for richer social sharing previews
proactive_recommendations.rationale: 1 of 1 pages (100%) are missing og:title, og:description, or og:image. Complete OpenGraph tags improve how content appears when shared on social media and in AI-powered link previews, driving referral traffic.

methodology_and_limitations.audit_scope: Evaluates technical AI discoverability, content extractability, structured data completeness, and citation readiness based on an observable crawl snapshot.
methodology_and_limitations.deterministic_scoring: All scoring formulas and journey deductions are 100% deterministic and rule-grounded, measuring concrete technical readiness rather than subjective or volatile LLM search rankings.
methodology_and_limitations.read_only_guarantee: This audit operates purely in read-only analysis mode without modifying site infrastructure, publishing changes, or executing non-idempotent operations.
limitations: Crawl depth is capped at 20 pages per run under standard execution parameters.
Dynamic Single-Page Application (SPA) content requires headless rendering with Playwright fallback when JavaScript rendering is enabled.
Content behind authentication, paywalls, or strict CAPTCHA barriers is outside audit scope.
